summary: Repoint T087 web-runs-page current-evidence reference from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; preserve T109 as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; explicitly mark pre-T112 T109, T105 and T063 manifests and pre-T112 evidence-unavailable runs as historical; keep Must-not byte-identical; add a sentence to References noting T112 is the current registry-bound source and T109 is preserved as predecessor history. T087 depends_on stays [T068, T084, T110] because T087 inherits T112 transitively through T084 and T110 (both already bind to T112 per A0032 and A0035). No business code, no workflow state, no Intent/Spec, no todo/config.yaml, no plan-structure, no tools/workflow/.claude/todo/schemas changes.
rationale: A0026 raised the A0026:T087:repoint-web-runs-page-to-t112-when-approved impact because T087's P08 web-runs contract continued to assert T109 manifest coverage and simulation-evidence availability as the current evidence source after T112 was DELIVERED with replaces=[T109]. T087 is an indirect T109 consumer (it depends on T068, T084 and T110, not on T109 directly), so the controller's CONTRACT drift check on depends_on does not flag a missing T112 edge. Instead, the contract text itself had to be retargeted: T109-as-current became T112-as-current. The retargeting is indirect through T084 (web provenance shell, already retargeted by A0032) and T110 (qualified replay, already retargeted by A0035); the Deliverables/Acceptance/References updates explicitly note that T087 reaches the T112 entry point through T084 and T110. T109, T105 and T063 manifests and pre-T112 successful runs are now marked historical (was 'pre-T109 T105 or pre-registry T063' → now 'pre-T112 T109, T105 or T063'). Must-not is byte-identical. References adds T112 as the current registry-bound source, retains T109 as a historical read-only predecessor, and adds a closing sentence. No Must-not, safety, execution, signer, risk, paper-promotion or credential clause was weakened; no task file other than T087 was edited; todo/config.yaml is byte-identical; active_task, active_phase, workflow_state, intent_revision, spec_revision and agent_runtime are unchanged.

A0026's intent-level cutover already moved T112 into the V1 simulation-evidence surface; A0036 only retargets a downstream P08 contract that lagged behind the cutover. No product-intent question is reopened by naming T112 as the indirect current source for T087.

The current-evidence source naming in T087 is a contract-level binding, not a Spec statement. The Spec-level cutover from T109 to T112 was already documented in T112 and recorded by spec_revision v1-2026-09-23-a0026-run-evidence-cutover.
impact_assessment.contracts: Applicable: only todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T087.md is edited. Deliverables and Acceptance retarget T109 manifest/entry point/artifacts to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; pre-T109 historical mentions become pre-T112 and explicitly include T109 alongside T105 and T063. References retargets T109 → T112 (current registry-bound source), preserves T109 as a historical read-only predecessor, and adds the closing sentence that T112 is the current registry-bound source and T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor. Must-not is byte-identical. Dependencies stays T068, T084, T110; T112 is intentionally not added because the indirect path through T084 and T110 already binds T112 (A0032 set T084.depends_on = [T025, T072, T080, T109, T112]; A0035 set T110.depends_on = [T040, T041, T052, T061, T100, T104, T109, T112]). No other task contract is touched.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable: todo/config.yaml is byte-identical. T087.depends_on stays [T068, T084, T110] per the Owner direction; the controller's _without_amendment_owned_config_fields excludes depends_on from the CONTRACT drift check, so no config edit is required for an indirect consumer and no config edit was made. T084 and T110 (the indirect T112 edges) already declare T112 in their depends_on lists via A0032 and A0035. No other task's record or dependencies were touched; active_task, active_phase, workflow_state, intent_revision, spec_revision and agent_runtime are unchanged.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. A0036 is contract-only. No business code is implemented, modified, tested, deleted or reverted. T087 remains OPEN with attempt=0 and no candidate/approved commit; no implementation gate is opened or closed. The Developer will follow the updated contract on a future T087 attempt.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. No data layout, schema, retention, storage, manifest-format, partition-reference, evidence-version, cursor-binding rule is changed. T112 is already the registry-bound simulation-evidence source per A0026; A0036 only updates how T087 names that source and which manifests are labelled historical.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. No operational runbook, lifecycle hook, replay path, signing, signer, paper-promotion or live-process surface is touched. The amendable runtime-cutover clause in T112 already lists T087 among the PLANNED indirect consumers that must be repointed; A0036 does not enable that cutover (T087 remains OPEN/PLANNED).
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T087 is a read-only Web page contract; no secret handling, authentication, signing, signer memory, keystore, wallet-control, key, permission or signing-payload surface is altered. No Must-not clause was weakened. T109 retained read-only; T105, T063 and T069 explicitly retained as historical predecessor artifacts.
impact_assessment.verification: Applicable: the controller's CONTRACT drift check at finish-amendment verifies that T087.md and todo/config.yaml agree on the dependencies set; both sides read [T068, T084, T110] and no T112 edge is asserted in either place, so the drift check passes without any config edit. No test, golden, fixture, oracle, tolerance, or acceptance gate was added, relaxed or removed. The Deliverables/Acceptance text now names T112 as the current evidence source reached indirectly through T084 and T110, so a future Developer implementing T087 will be forced to read T112 evidence (not T109) via the already-repointed T084/T110 surfaces. The pre-T112 historical clause and the pre-T112 evidence-unavailable label give a Developer time to keep T109 T069/T105/T063 manifests byte-identical and visibly legacy.
